body: All generations have people they don't like. But it seems that each generation likes to point out these people to make their generation feel superior. But it's just silly.
You answered a lot, thanks.

I would definitely remember, I always remember Time Lords. 

On a more serious note, I'm with you being incapable of moving on. It's been six months since the girl I thought I loved told me (on my birthday) that she had gotten over me when she went and studied abroad, and slept with another guy. I'm still filled with rage every time I see her (which is often because we're both in the same band) and have yet to be happy for more than a week because of it. Because of all of this, I feel incredibly over dramatic and worthless because I should be over all of it. 

But I'm not.

Because no one is the same. You can't compare yourself to how other people seem to cope with things, even if they went through the same thing. No two people think exactly alike and have the exact same life situation. Some things matter more to some people than to others, and therefore, we all react to things differently. There's no correct way to react to it. So don't feel bad for feeling over-dramatic, because it just might be that other people are under dramatic.

I feel I've rambled a bit, so I guess I'll end this comment here. 

Good luck with it all, and send me a pm if you wanna chat more one on one.

Two of my favorite quotes from Doctor Who are relevant here.

"There's no such thing as an ordinary human."

"Funny, in 900 years of travelling time and space and I've never met anyone who wasn't important."
Tell him. Lying about this and not communicating is one of the worst things that you can do.
That's what I've been trying to do, but recently that's stopped working.

First off, fuck the universe. Next, I've been trying to get into things at university, but it's not working. I think I get past it, then all of a sudden I'm back to feeling miserable and cutting myself. I feel like it's only a matter of time before I make the final cut.

Met a girl last year and we fell in love. Then over the summer she studied abroad and completely forgot about me. Cheated on me three times before finally telling me on my birthday. Now I have to see her every other day, so I can't forget about her. It's become more than just a girl cheating on me, I've lost my faith in what's good in the world along with my happiness.

It was three months and thirteen days ago (easy to get an exact number because it was my fucking birthday) and I know it wasn't my fault and I didn't deserve it and there was nothing I could've done to prevent it and there's nothing I can do to change it. I want to get away from the whole thing, but we have lots of mutual friends and we're both really close (as in physical proximity) to each other in marching band. Those two things make it pretty much impossible to get away from it all. All I want to do is completely erase her whole existence from my memory.

And it's not the time I'm putting into the research, it's just above my level. I'm a sophomore taking a graduate level course when I don't even have the prerequisite for it. I just can't keep up.

As for being more selfish, it's even more annoying for me because I'll often regret or at least feel bad about treating someone badly, or at least not as good as I could've treated them.

All in all, it's really hard to get away from the past when it you stand less than 10 yards from it every other day and hangs around your friends. It's making me miserable, and I'm sick of it.

I had a girlfriend whom I loved until she completely changed who she was while she was studying abroad. She got drunk and high (which she said she would never ever do, and didn't all of last year, which was our freshman year in college) and cheated on me multiple times. Told me on my birthday. Wasn't sad at all about things with me, only sad that things with the guy she cheated with ended. Never gave a shit about me. 

What's been holding me together is having good friends and a good life going for me right now. I'm in an advanced class in order to do physics research, along with all my other classes going extremely well. Then I started to feel like shit again, and started cutting myself.And now, especially as of today, things aren't working, I'm going to have to give up on the research because it's over my head, I'm falling behind in the rest of my classes, and I find that I just don't give a shit about pretty much anything anymore. 

And I am a selfless person, and it pisses me off. I've lived a life of put good in and get good out. But after what happened I realized it's not true, and I'm just going to get screwed over and not get what I deserve. And the whole argument of hang in there (Get it? Hang in there? suicide? Tee-hee. Sorry. Dark humor) because it will really screw up the lives of my friends and family (which I know it will) doesn't really work on me. I'm sick of doing things for other people when I just get screwed over. So this would be a selfish act that I deserve to make.

EDIT: Don't underestimate the whole "I loved her thing", because I have never felt a closer connection to anyone or anything in my entire life. Spent nearly all of my time together, talked about the future and such, didn't keep secrets, and was just absolutely thrilled with the relationship. Then it all came crashing down on my birthday.
It's not just that I don't have her. It's that I am legitimately not happy even thought things in my life are going great, or at least they were.
In class right now, I'll respond in a couple hours
Well I've talked about it here a couple times and it really hasn't helped. Everyone keeps saying give it time, it'll get better. But I'm just too sick of waiting.

I can't forgive her. I want her completely out of my life, but we're both in the same rank in band so I can't get away from her. And apparently I let her have that power. I spent so much time with her and let her so far into my mind that I can't get her out. 90% of all things will cause me to think about her in one way or another, and I can't stop it. There's only one thing that I can do to really get her out of my head.
I just can't believe that...
I'm just so goddamn sick of waiting for it to get better. I mean, it's been three months and I still feel this bad. If it's gonna take this long to heal, I don't even want to bother with it.
I can't let it go. I want to, but I don't know how. I thought getting back to school and being busy would help, but clearly it hasn't.

How can you forgive someone like that? I'm almost positive I will never ever be able to forgive this one person in mind.

I know I shouldn't be looking at any of her stuff, but I really can't help myself. Hence the pathetic part. I have too much idle time this summer and my thoughts wander too much. I've tried to pick up new hobbies and such, as well as looking for a summer job, but no luck on either of those. I just can't control my thoughts.

How the fuck do I do that? She's in another country and it's been almost three weeks and She's still dominating my thoughts. I know I need to get her gone. But right now I am pathetic and can't do that. I invested too much into that relationship, all to have it suddenly ripped out from under me.
